name: one-pager-builder
description: Create one-page sales documents — product overviews, meeting leave-behinds, champion enablement sheets, trade show handouts. Scannable in 30 seconds, memorable enough to forward. Use when creating one-pagers, leave-behinds, quick reference sheets, or sales handouts. Triggers on: "one-pager", "leave-behind", "product overview", "handout", "champion doc", "sales sheet", or any request for a single-page sales document.
